mechanism: Lock one architectural or system cross-section and preserve its structural anchors throughout. Begin from an incomplete but spatially readable shell, then apply irreversible completion stages in causal order: cleanup or stabilization, surface envelope, functional infrastructure, occupancy components and one final activation proof. Never move the camera to hide continuity; the finished state must remain directly comparable to the opening geometry.

invariants.rule: Lock one wide composition with at least three structural anchors visible for the full sequence.
invariants.purpose: Makes every later stage directly comparable.
invariants.ablation_failure: Moving the camera can conceal replacement rather than completion.

invariants.rule: Begin from an incomplete but readable shell and complete its base surfaces first.
invariants.ablation_failure: Adding decoration before stabilizing the shell breaks causal construction order.

invariants.rule: Add one functional envelope or infrastructure stage while preserving all structural anchors.
invariants.purpose: Moves from appearance to usable system.
invariants.ablation_failure: Surface recolor alone cannot prove functional progress.

invariants.rule: Populate distinct zones with occupancy or operational components without blocking the spatial comparison.
invariants.purpose: Assigns purpose to the finished shell.
invariants.ablation_failure: Random clutter hides whether the same space persists.

invariants.rule: Use one final activation proof and hold the complete state in the opening composition.
invariants.ablation_failure: Ending before activation leaves completion ambiguous.

slots.name: lead_subject
slots.constraint: An original stable subject or pair with a readable role.

slots.name: setting
slots.constraint: A new setting with fixed spatial anchors and no source-specific surface.

slots.name: escalation_variable
slots.constraint: One causal variable that changes through visible stages.

slots.name: performance_rule
slots.constraint: A restrained acting or motion rule that keeps the mechanism legible.

slots.name: camera_grammar
slots.constraint: An information order that proves each state without copying source shot boundaries.

slots.name: payoff
slots.constraint: A clean final physical, informational or social consequence.

slots.name: sound_family
slots.constraint: An original hierarchy of diegetic cues; no unsupported source-audio claim.

anti_copy_exclusions: the source damaged pale-green apartment shell
the source exact doorways, rear window and corridor layout
the source light wood floor, white walls, sofa, dining chairs and pendant lights
the source Hailuo/MiniMax and AI-generated watermark marks

instantiations.concept: In an original orbital greenhouse cutaway, a locked wide view begins with an empty pressure frame.
